_comment: Accepted Semgrep findings (contrib/semgrep/README.md, 'Accepting a finding'). findings: fingerprint -> {rule, path, reason, by, date}. rule_paths: [{rule (glob), paths (globs), reason, by, date}]. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check.

aa4514c27a5ce3be.reason: The format string is _(literal) + _(literal). _() (src/util.h) returns its input unless a translation function is set, and ycashd sets none, so the format is a compile-time literal whose six arguments match its %s count.

9d7faa1858cffaa0.reason: yed_estimatecollateral lockBlocks: params[1] is checked isNum() and then ClassForLockBlocks() returns -1 outside every term class, which the handler refuses (mint-bad-lock) before any use.

6a5797dd0bb3078e.reason: yed_mint cents: PreflightMint -> MintGate (src/yellowback/txbuilder.cpp) refuses cents outside [minMint, maxMint] before any transaction is built.

587c9c98eab87bae.reason: yed_mint lockBlocks: PreflightMint -> MintGate refuses a lockBlocks outside every term class (mint-bad-lock) before any transaction is built.

f6e08713abbc8086.reason: yed_send cents: DoSend -> BuildTransfer refuses each amount outside [minOutput, maxOutput] (bad-xfer-amount).

31f2ebaf1b22bffe.reason: priceMicroUsd (yed_revive): BuildRevive -> SignAttestationGuarded refuses a price outside [PRICE_MIN, PRICE_MAX] (attest-range) before signing.

31f2ebaf1b22bffe-1.reason: priceMicroUsd (yed_signattestation): SignAttestationGuarded refuses a price outside [PRICE_MIN, PRICE_MAX] (attest-range) before signing.

a22287cf3d83e854.reason: citedHeight: SignAttestationGuarded refuses a citedHeight outside [startHeight, chainHeight] (attest-stale) before signing.

269dfc6ab4ea25b4.reason: (CAmount)(12.5 * COIN) is a constant expression copied from GetBlockSubsidy (src/main.cpp), exactly 1250000000 in IEEE-754; the issued-supply sum itself is arith_uint256 integer arithmetic.

1358f38e2b0994a2.reason: signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN) installs the SIG_IGN disposition only; no handler function ever runs, so the portability and reentrancy concerns behind the rule (unspecified reset/restart semantics of a user handler under signal()) do not arise. The handlers that do run (HandleSIGTERM/HandleSIGHUP, which only set flags) are installed with sigaction() just above. Upstream Zcash/Bitcoin init.cpp idiom; the ignore must stay or a peer closing a socket mid-write kills the daemon.

1e229b6b4076c622.reason: logicalTS <= prevLogicalTS compares two unsigned int timestamps for ordering, not an unsigned value against zero: prevLogicalTS starts at 0 and is overwritten by ReadTimestampBlockIndex of the previous block, and the branch makes the insight timestamp index strictly monotonic (logicalTS = prev + 1). With prevLogicalTS == 0 the comparison is only true for logicalTS == 0, which is the intended bump. Upstream Zcash insight-explorer code in a consensus file (workspace CLAUDE.md rule 7): not refactored.

0da0cca2aa3edd15.reason: htalloc::alloc() checks the calloc() result on the next line with assert(mem), and assertions cannot be compiled out of this node (src/crypto/common.h: #error when NDEBUG is defined), so a NULL from calloc aborts before any use. The sizes are compile-time constants (sizeof(digit0), sizeof(digit1), 2*NBUCKETS, MAXSOLS), so no attacker-chosen allocation size reaches it. Upstream tromp equihash solver in src/pow/ (workspace CLAUDE.md rule 7): converting the abort into an error path is a behaviour change in PoW code for an OOM at miner start-up, not a safety gain; accepted.

56e35d7149015f9a.reason: realloc(_union.indirect, ((size_t)sizeof(T)) * new_capacity): new_capacity is prevector::size_type (uint32_t) and the product is computed in size_t after the explicit cast, which is the explicit cast upstream Bitcoin added to this line for exactly this wraparound. Every element type instantiated (unsigned char for CScript, the CTxIn/CTxOut-sized prevectors) has sizeof(T) far below 2^32, so the product fits 64 bits; and the capacity itself is bounded by callers: deserialization grows a prevector in MAX_SIZE-bounded chunks (serialize.h Unserialize_impl) and script sizes are bounded by MAX_SCRIPT_SIZE. Consensus-adjacent header (workspace CLAUDE.md rule 7): not refactored.

568e5c7850ebda01.reason: malloc(((size_t)sizeof(T)) * new_capacity): same argument as the realloc branch two lines above (fingerprint 56e35d7149015f9a): new_capacity is uint32_t, the product is computed in size_t after the explicit cast (the cast upstream Bitcoin added for this), sizeof(T) of every instantiation is tiny, and the capacity is bounded by MAX_SIZE-chunked deserialization and MAX_SCRIPT_SIZE. The result is checked with assert(new_indirect), and assertions cannot be compiled out (src/crypto/common.h). Not refactored (rule 7).

034b8af301b53b5e.reason: pchCommand is the 12-byte fixed-width P2P wire field (COMMAND_SIZE), serialized with FLATDATA and deliberately not NUL-terminated when the command is exactly 12 characters: that is the Bitcoin wire format. The constructor memsets it to zero first; no reader treats it as a C string: GetCommand() uses strnlen(pchCommand, COMMAND_SIZE) and IsValid() walks exactly COMMAND_SIZE bytes requiring printable ASCII then zero padding. pszCommand comes only from string literals in net.cpp PushMessage/BeginMessage, never from the network. Consensus/wire serialization (workspace CLAUDE.md rule 7): not refactored.

ca0632a5ae448f13.reason: CSignatureCache::Set: `nMaxCacheSize <= 0` on size_t is exactly `== 0`, the intended 'eviction disabled' early return for -maxsigcachesize=0 (upstream Zcash 2.x sigcache.cpp). A negative -maxsigcachesize wraps to a huge bound and merely stops eviction of the operator's own cache: a local configuration footgun, not a network-reachable issue. src/script/ (workspace CLAUDE.md rule 7): not rewritten.

78d3bd506bf39c70.reason: fSortedByFee = (nBlockPrioritySize <= 0): nBlockPrioritySize is unsigned int, so this is exactly `== 0`, the intended 'no priority area, sort by fee' switch (-blockprioritysize=0). It is clamped to [0, nBlockMaxSize] by std::min just above and only ever compared against sizes. Upstream Bitcoin 0.11 CreateNewBlock idiom; rewriting it as == 0 changes nothing.

4c8538afb45739b3.reason: maxConfirms is size_t and is set from fileConfAvg.size(), so `maxConfirms <= 0` is exactly `== 0`; together with the `> 6*24*7` arm it bounds the fee-estimates file's confirm count to [1, 1008] before any resize or index. The input is the node's own fee_estimates.dat, and a corrupt file throws here. Upstream Bitcoin 0.12 TxConfirmStats::Read idiom.

rule_paths.reason: Test vectors, regtest keys and documentation examples, not real secrets (checked 2026-10-22). A secret anywhere else is still reported.
